# How To Share A Notebook

Notebooks are a core part of Fernbook. You'll find sharing options in two places.

- Open the notebook.
- Click **Share**.
- Enter your teammate's email address.

# Reset your password

Reset your password when you forget it or when an admin asks you to.

1. On the sign-in page, click **Forgot password**.
2. Enter the email address for your account.
3. Open the reset email and follow the link within 2 hours.
4. Log in with the new password.

When the new password works, Fernbook opens your home page. If the link expires, request a new one from the login page.

# Sync stops on a metered connection

Kestrel Sync pauses itself on metered connections to save data.

## Symptom

The tray icon turns gray, and files stop syncing.

## Cause

The connection is flagged by your operating system as metered. As mentioned above, Kestrel Sync pauses on such connections.

## Fix

You might want to turn off **Pause on metered connections** in **Settings** > **Network**.

# Connect Fernbook to your identity provider

Connect Fernbook to your identity provider so your team signs in with one account.

1. In Settings, open the Single sign-on tab.
2. Paste the metadata URL, the entity ID and the certificate.
3. Click Save.
4. Run fernbook-cli verify-sso to test the connection.

When the test passes, the tab shows a green check mark.

# Archive a workspace

Welcome aboard! Archiving is one of our most requested features. Please note that the user must be a workspace owner in order to archive a workspace, and archived workspaces stay readable for every member until an owner restores them or deletes them for good.

1. Open **Workspace settings**.
2. Click **Archive workspace**.

# Export formats

Choose an export format before you export a notebook.

- **PDF:** A fixed layout for printing — best for sharing.
- **Markdown** – Plain text with formatting marks (e.g. headings and code).
- **HTML** – A web page with images & styles inline.

# Pin a note

Pin a note to keep it at the top of its notebook.

1. Open the note.
2. Click **More** > **Pin to top**.

The note moves to the top of the list. To unpin it, click **More** > **Unpin**.

# Recover a deleted note

Recover a deleted note from the trash within 30 days of deleting it.

1. In the sidebar, click **Trash**.
2. Select the note.
3. Click **Restore**.

The note returns to its original notebook. After 30 days, Fernbook deletes it permanently.
